result.summary: The image depicts a residential street with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. While the pedestrian infrastructure is present, the crossing lacks active traffic control and suffers from sightline obstructions due to parked vehicles near the intersection.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on both sides of the street are located immediately adjacent to the crosswalk, which can hide pedestrians, especially children, from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Curbside parking on both the left and right sides of the street leading up to the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The crossing lacks stop signs or signals for the primary direction of travel, requiring pedestrians to rely on driver yielding behavior on a relatively wide street.
hazards.location_in_image: The intersection area where the crosswalk is located.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20 feet of the crosswalk and install curb extensions to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians while shortening the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a raised crosswalk to serve as a traffic calming measure, slowing vehicle speeds and increasing the prominence of the pedestrian crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install 'Yield to Pedestrian' signage (R1-6) or standard pedestrian crossing warning signs to alert drivers to the presence of the crosswalk.

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks, but pedestrian safety is hindered by significant sidewalk obstructions and poor pavement quality. Visibility is also compromised by parked vehicles near the crossing points and a lack of dedicated pedestrian signals.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large pile of trash bags completely blocks the sidewalk on the left side of the image, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.

hazards.name: Restricted Sightlines
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the right side of the street are positioned very close to the crosswalk, obscuring visibility between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the church

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The asphalt within the intersection and crosswalk area shows significant cracking and uneven surfaces, creating potential trip hazards.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalks to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and physically prevent illegal parking near the intersection.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Clearance
interventions.description: Implement regular debris removal and repair the cracked pavement to ensure a clear, accessible path of travel.
